correctness.rationale: The representation H_t=e^{t tr B}U P_t* U^-1 and the Gaussian chaos decomposition produce the exact Fock singular-value product. An energy identity makes its finite-time compactness criterion equivalent to full Kalman rank. The block-scaled Gramian converges to a strictly positive polynomial-moment matrix G; this proves the exact exponent and leading constant for all fixed positive p. Nonincreasing Kalman increments give sharp rank bounds; a skew chain plus scalar damping attains the upper endpoint. A Hilbert/Cauchy determinant yields the all-dimensional factorial coefficient. d=3 Gram determinant 1/1080 and high-precision t sequence independently support algebra. Tests are not used in place of proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed new invariant is the all-dimension Kalman-graded Schatten leading power and exact positive coefficient, its sharp diffusion-rank envelope, and an explicit extremal skew chain, for dimension at least three. Bruno et al. provide nondegenerate inverse Gaussian conjugation and spectral theory but not these rank-sensitive quantities. Araki et al. provide the exact general Fock Schatten product, expressly used as an input; the finite-time product itself is not claimed as new. Existing two-dimensional inverse OU amplification and ellipticity-edge results are excluded from the novelty claim. Targeted prior-record and primary-literature comparison found no direct graded-rank coverage, but older controllability / Fock literature could hide an equivalent reformulation.
residual_risks: A stronger older theorem could combine trace-ideal second quantization with Kalman small-time Gramian determinants and already imply the rank-sharp formula.
Full source text of the 2026 quantum Gaussian analogue and some older control and hypoelliptic work was not available for complete comparison.
Novelty of the dimension-two planar case is expressly not claimed.

value.rationale: At fixed diffusion rank, the theorem determines a natural sharp spectral-ideal blow-up exponent, including its positive coefficient and a model attaining the maximal severity in every dimension. The rank-one model has nuclear \(t^{-d^2}\) but ordinary trace \(t^{-d}\), a growing nonnormality gap invisible in the generator eigenvalues. The statement is a motivated structural classification, not an arbitrary low-dimensional sample or restatement of the generic Fock product formula.
